summary.text: Sarah Crawford is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 66 in Wake County since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the state Senate and is CEO of the Tammy Lynn Center, according to the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Crawford earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University in 2003, according to Ballotpedia.
She served in North Carolina State Senate District 18 from 2021 to 2023, then assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Ben Moss (R).
The General Assembly lists her occupation as CEO of the Tammy Lynn Center and records two terms in the House and one in the Senate.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
